'''Arhul Manaxa''' was scholar emeritus at the [[University of Rudrig/Legends|University of Rudrig]]. He was interviewed in [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]] by [[Eschul Shaywa]], correspondent for [[Imperial Center Today]], for the latter's article "[[A LONG TIME AGO...]]," regarding the [[Zhell–Taung war|Zhell-Taung War]].
